with `c` = 0.5 times (floats `[rcx+0x50]`/`+0x54`/`+0x58` plus `[rcx+0x40]`/`+0x44`/`+0x48`) and `e` = 0.5 times their differences (both zero when dword `[rcx+0x1C]` is 0), adds the results of three calls to its own vtable slot `+0x50` to the z, y and x of `e` in call order; with the transform at `rdx` (rows `+0`, `+0x10`, `+0x20`, origin `+0x30`), takes `w` = for each row i the row's three floats dotted with `c` plus origin component i, and `x` = for each row the absolute values of its three floats dotted with `e`; writes (`w` - `x`, 0) to `[r8]` and (`w` + `x`, 0) to `[r9]`

for each j below `r9d` (signed), with `v` = the 16-byte direction at `rdx+16j`, `r` = float `[rcx+0x30]` and `h` = float `[rcx+0x34]` (both re-read each time), takes `s` = `sqrtf` (`00861F14`)(`v`.x^2 + `v`.z^2) and writes to `r8+16j` the 16 bytes (x, y, z, w): y = `h`, negated when `v`.y is below 0 (not for NaN); when `s` equals 0.0 (ordered), x = `r` and z = 0, otherwise x = `v`.x times `r`/`s` and z = `v`.z times `r`/`s`; w is a stack dword the body never writes

for each j below `r9d` (signed), with `v` = the x/y/z floats of the 16-byte direction at `rdx+16j`, dots `v` with the rows at `rcx+0x50`, `+0x60` and `+0x70` (floats `+0`/`+4`/`+8` of each) giving `d0`, `d1`, `d2`, picks row 1 when `d1` > `d0` (then row 2 if `d2` > `d1`), else row 2 when `d2` > `d0`, else row 0 (ties and NaN keep the earlier row), and copies that 16-byte row to `r8+16j`
